component.name: TikTok Transcriber
component.summary: Readable transcripts from public clips, on your computer

description.p: TikTok Transcriber turns public TikTok videos and profiles into readable transcripts. Recognition runs locally with integrated Qwen and Whisper models: audio is not uploaded to a transcription service.

ul.li: One video, selected gallery items, or a complete public profile
Readable paragraphs in Markdown or plain text, with optional timestamps
A file per video, a combined collection and a CSV metadata index
Four integrated model choices with automatic downloads
Fourteen interface languages, dark and light themes, reduced motion

description.p: Security update: Brotli 1.2.1 fixes an out-of-bounds write in its decoder (CVE-2026-111497).
macOS and Linux builds, installers and package-manager installs.
